title: Continuum Backup & Recovery Rate Card — List Rates, Terms and Discounts
content:
Continuum Backup & Recovery is priced per protected item, on six tiers from Continuum Backup Basic to Continuum DRaaS Premier. Each tier publishes a list monthly fee for each class of protected item, the term lengths it is offered on, a discount off list rates by term length, and a discount off list rates for clients that also hold a ClearPath agreement.

## List monthly fees per protected item (USD)

| Tier | Per protected server | Per protected workstation | Per protected Microsoft 365 user |
|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 39.00 | 7.50 | 2.75 |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 59.00 | 9.50 | 3.25 |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 79.00 | 11.50 | 3.75 |
| Continuum BDR | 119.00 | 14.00 | 3.75 |
| Continuum DRaaS | 189.00 | 16.00 | 4.25 |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 265.00 | 18.50 | 4.75 |

The Microsoft 365 user fee covers mailbox, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams.

## Terms offered and term discount off list rates

| Tier | Terms offered (months) | Discount by term length |
|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 1 or 12 | 1 month: 0 percent; 12 months: 0 percent |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 1 or 12 | 1 month: 0 percent; 12 months: 0 percent |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 12 or 36 | 12 months: 0 percent; 36 months: 5 percent |
| Continuum BDR | 12 or 36 | 12 months: 0 percent; 36 months: 5 percent |
| Continuum DRaaS | 12 or 36 | 12 months: 0 percent; 36 months: 7 percent |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 36 only | 36 months: 7 percent |

## ClearPath bundle discount off list rates

The bundle discount is the discount off list rates when the client holds an active ClearPath agreement at or above the lowest qualifying ClearPath tier rank. ClearPath tier ranks run from 1 to 6.

| Tier | Bundle discount | Lowest qualifying ClearPath tier rank |
|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 0 percent | 3 |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 0 percent | 3 |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 5 percent | 3 |
| Continuum BDR | 5 percent | 3 |
| Continuum DRaaS | 7.5 percent | 3 |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 7.5 percent | 3 |

## Reading the card

- A term length that does not appear in a tier's row is not offered on that tier; for example, Continuum DRaaS Premier is offered on a 36-month term only, and a 36-month term is not offered on Continuum Backup Basic or Continuum Backup Standard.
- On Continuum Backup Basic and Continuum Backup Standard both the term discount and the bundle discount are 0 percent for every offered term, so the list rates on those tiers are not reduced by either discount.
- The qualifying ClearPath rank is 3 on every tier; a ClearPath agreement at rank 2 or below is beneath it, and one at rank 3 or above meets it.
